title: Escrow Administration | Tax, Insurance & Reserve Tracking | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Escrow administration for commercial loans: tracking tax, insurance, and reserve obligations tied to the collateral, with alerts and an audit trail.
h1: Escrow administration tied to the collateral
lede: For commercial real estate loans, taxes, insurance, and reserves protect the collateral. We track those obligations as part of servicing rather than leaving them in a spreadsheet.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Where a loan carries escrow or reserve obligations, we inventory them, track due dates and coverage, and alert before an item lapses or a deadline is missed.
bullets: Inventory of tax, insurance, and reserve obligations
Alerts ahead of lapse or deadline

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Escrow items are tracked against the loan's requirements, and activity is recorded in the servicing trail. This connects directly to insurance compliance monitoring so a lapse is caught as a servicing event.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Escrow status and upcoming obligations are visible in portfolio reporting, so lenders see exposure before it becomes a problem.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Tracking escrow inside servicing means tax and insurance gaps surface as alerts, not as surprises at claim time or covenant review.

faqs.a: No — escrow and reserve requirements vary by loan. We administer them where a loan carries them and confirm the requirements during boarding.

faqs.q: How does escrow relate to insurance monitoring?
faqs.a: Escrow administration coordinates with insurance compliance monitoring so a coverage lapse is caught as a tracked servicing event.
